## 11. Memory evidence

A recursive retained-object measurement on real `ResolvedComponent` instances reports
approximately **5,773 bytes per resolved result** in the benchmark fixture. A shared-graph
measurement of the cache entry mapping reports approximately:

- 1 result: 6,222 bytes;
- 10 results: 35,435 bytes;
- 100 results: 331,201 bytes;
- 1,000 results: 3,277,941 bytes.

These are Python object-size engineering measurements, not allocator-level production
memory certification. They are retained as capacity evidence rather than used to invent
a byte-based cache policy.

## 12. Statistics / telemetry

`ResolutionCacheStats` remains an immutable snapshot with:

- hits;
- misses;
- stores;
- evictions.

No new production telemetry field was added. There is no production consumer requiring
one, and the single-flight behavior is independently observable through runtime tests and
benchmark evidence.

## 13. Versioning

```text
ENGINE_VERSION   = 1.3.8
SCHEMA_VERSION   = 2
RESOLUTION_VERSION = 20
```

No version bump is required because V1.41 changes concurrency/lifecycle behavior without
changing the resolution semantics or fingerprint identity.

## 14. COLOR boundary

No change was made to:

- `runtime/effect_color.py`;
- `runtime/effects.py`;
- `runtime/color_spaces.py`.

The existing `effect.color.srgb8-interpolation` operation remains the sole certified
production color-modifying path.

## 15. Acceptance criteria

V1.41 is accepted only if all are true:

- [x] same-key forced MISS produces exactly one build;
- [x] waiters receive the same immutable result object;
- [x] visual output is identical across concurrent callers;
- [x] provenance is identical across concurrent callers;
- [x] different keys can build concurrently;
- [x] builder exceptions reach all current waiters;
- [x] failed keys can be retried;
- [x] `clear()` cannot be repopulated by a pre-clear active build;
- [x] completed flight state does not accumulate beyond cache residency;
- [x] stale graph rejection still occurs before cache lookup;
- [x] frame-style caller hand-off works without global ownership;
- [x] cross-surface dependency partition remains unchanged;
- [x] COLOR runtime boundary remains unchanged;
- [x] visual runtime board inspected.
